#!/bin/sh
# salt-005 — self-extracting mirror payload
# Source commit: 5944ab1
# Packed by tools/make_payload.sh — do not hand-edit; ship a new number instead.
set -u
NAME=salt-005
SOURCE_COMMIT=5944ab1
ARCHIVE_SHA256=68c8b88f8ff2adee82e71d0b2ac4c647ed4b371d1ed6a33fa86441fe1438bf00
FILES=2
PAYLOAD_SHA256=36d8e43635998998b3afb5b18c720c13867e0662d7bcb4f86f585c2f782338f7
[ -f "$0" ] || { echo "SALT_005_FAIL=run-from-file"; exit 1; }
[ $# -eq 1 ] || { echo "SALT_005_FAIL=usage: sh /path/to/salt-005.txt /absolute/dir"; exit 1; }
DEST=$1
case "$DEST" in /*|[A-Za-z]:/*) ;; *) echo "SALT_005_FAIL=absolute required"; exit 1 ;; esac
if [ -e "$DEST" ]; then echo "SALT_005_FAIL=target-already-exists:$DEST — run: rm -rf $DEST"; exit 1; fi
for c in base64 tar mktemp find sort; do
    command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "SALT_005_FAIL=missing:$c"; exit 1; }
done
command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "SALT_005_FAIL=missing:sha256sum-or-shasum"; exit 1; }
hash_of() {
    if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1
    else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}
hash_stream() {
    if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1
    else shasum -a 256 | cut -d' ' -f1; fi
}
TMP=$(mktemp -d) || { echo "SALT_005_FAIL=mktemp"; exit 1; }
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT INT TERM
sed -n '/^__SALT_005_PAYLOAD__$/,$p' "$0" | tail -n +2 > "$TMP/b64.txt"
if ! base64 -d "$TMP/b64.txt" > "$TMP/src.tar.gz" 2>/dev/null; then
    base64 -D "$TMP/b64.txt" > "$TMP/src.tar.gz" 2>/dev/null || { echo "SALT_005_FAIL=base64"; exit 1; }
fi
GOT=$(hash_of "$TMP/src.tar.gz")
echo "ARCHIVE_SHA256_GOT=$GOT"
if [ "$GOT" != "$ARCHIVE_SHA256" ]; then echo "SALT_005_FAIL=archive-sha want=$ARCHIVE_SHA256 got=$GOT"; exit 1; fi
mkdir -p "$DEST" || { echo "SALT_005_FAIL=mkdir"; exit 1; }
tar -xzf "$TMP/src.tar.gz" -C "$DEST" || { echo "SALT_005_FAIL=tar"; exit 1; }
GOT2=$(cd "$DEST" && find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | hash_stream)
echo "PAYLOAD_SHA256_GOT=$GOT2"
if [ "$GOT2" != "$PAYLOAD_SHA256" ]; then echo "SALT_005_FAIL=payload-sha want=$PAYLOAD_SHA256 got=$GOT2"; exit 1; fi
echo "SALT_005_DONE=YES"
echo "FILES=$FILES DEST=$DEST"
echo "--- inverse ---"
echo "ARCHIVE_SHA256_WANT=$ARCHIVE_SHA256 ARCHIVE_SHA256_GOT=$GOT PAYLOAD_SHA256_WANT=$PAYLOAD_SHA256 PAYLOAD_SHA256_GOT=$GOT2 FILES=$FILES DEST=$DEST"
exit 0
__SALT_005_PAYLOAD__
